title: Wings — Outboard Flap Carriage Supports — Installation of Thickened Bearing Land Fittings

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Flap Support Structure

abstract: Replacement of the outboard flap carriage support fittings by thickened, sleeved items on delivered CIRRANE-13 aircraft, restoring the fitting life to its design service goal and withdrawing the interim pin bore inspection.

sections.planning_reason: Teardown of two outboard flap carriage support fittings returned from high-cycle aircraft found fretting in the carriage pin bore that the original substantiation did not predict, projecting a fitting life of about 42 000 flight cycles against a design service goal of 60 000. An interim repeat inspection of the pin bore at every 6 000 flight cycles was introduced in 2023 and is expensive because it needs the flap extended and a borescope. The CIRRANE-11 carries a lower carriage load and is not in the effectivity.
sections.description: The four outboard flap carriage support lugs are replaced by items with a 4 mm thicker bearing land on each face and a hard anodised bore sleeve. The adjacent cleat is replaced by a taller item so that the load path into the fixed trailing edge is unchanged, and the shear tie is re-drilled to the new pattern. The carriage locking mechanism proximity target is repositioned to follow the fitting face.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Extend the flap fully and make the flap system safe. Remove the trailing edge lower panel in zone 525 on the side being worked. Remove the flap carriage pin and support the flap on the carriage cradle. Remove the support lug D5730124726204 and the cleat BRDE298405-27. Do a detailed visual inspection of the fixed trailing edge rib land and record any finding. Re-drill the shear tie D5730118419315 to the new pattern using the drill jig and do a dye penetrant inspection of every new hole. Install the thickened lug and the taller cleat and fasten to the torque values given in the accomplishment instructions. Reposition the proximity target of the locking mechanism 8VU9 and set the gap. Install the flap carriage pin and do the flap drive system test. Install the trailing edge panel and do the flap position rigging check. Record the embodiment and remove the interim pin bore inspection from the maintenance schedule.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-13 aircraft MSN C00001 through C00650 that are pre modification standard. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00655 onward were built with the thickened fittings. The CIRRANE-11 is not affected and no equivalent bulletin is planned for it.
sections.material_note: Kit K5730-1006-01 contains four sleeved lugs, four cleats, the fastener set and the drill jig hire. The sleeved lug is a long lead item at thirty-eight weeks and orders should be placed at least two checks ahead of the planned embodiment.

type_data.compliance_time: Before 45 000 flight cycles, or at the next flap removal, whichever occurs first.
